title: Star-Lord to Stalin in five real photos?
description: Five real photos connect Chris Pratt to Joseph Stalin, through a governor and three presidents.
hook: How is Chris Pratt connected to Joseph Stalin?

links.line: In 2025, Chris Pratt joined his father-in-law, Arnold Schwarzenegger, at the premiere of FUBAR.

image.file: File:President Ronald Reagan with Arnold Schwarzenegger Retouched (cropped).jpg

links.line: In 1984, Arnold, already famous as the Terminator, met President Ronald Reagan at the Republican convention.

image.file: File:Four Presidents (Reagan Ford Carter Nixon) Pose for a Portrait Prior to Leaving for Egypt and President Anwar Sadat'S Funeral - DPLA - 11150d197bcd8b923bf519eaad8aeefd.jpg

links.line: In 1981, Reagan posed with Richard Nixon at the White House before Nixon flew to Sadat's funeral.

image.file: File:Nixon meeting with former President Harry S.Truman - NARA - 194615.tif

links.line: In 1969, Nixon visited Harry Truman in Missouri and played him a song on the piano.

image.file: File:President Truman (center) speaks with Soviet Prime Minister Josef Stalin (at left) and British Prime Minister Winston... - NARA - 198775.jpg

links.line: And in 1945, Truman met Joseph Stalin at the Potsdam Conference to decide the fate of postwar Europe.
